About Linger

Linger keeps your downtime list in one place: movies, TV, books, games, music, podcasts, articles, places, restaurants, and websites. Share a link from any app and it lands in your Inbox. Linger is free to use, with no account, no ads, and no tracking. Linger Plus is optional.

Common Questions

Is Linger free? Do I need an account?

Yes, and no account is needed. Every title, episode, note and list is free, with no advertising and no analytics. Linger Plus is an optional subscription ($2.99 a month or $19.99 a year, 7-day free trial, Family Sharing included) that adds unlimited saved filters, weather on your planned evenings, and Release spotlight. Your first saved filter is free, and anything you already saved never locks. Restore or manage Plus from the Linger Plus row on the Shelves tab.

How do I add something?

Tap the plus button and search the catalog, and the cover and details fill in for you. Or share a link from any app and choose Linger; it lands in your Inbox. Articles, places, restaurants, and websites can be added by hand.

The Share option doesn't show Linger.

In the share sheet, scroll the row of apps to the end and tap More, then turn on Linger. If you still don't see it, restart the app you are sharing from.

Do my lists sync between my iPhone and iPad?

Yes, if both devices are signed in to the same Apple Account with iCloud enabled. Sync uses your own private iCloud database — nothing goes to a server we run, and we cannot see your library. If you are not signed in to iCloud, Linger works normally and keeps everything on that one device.

My library isn't syncing.

Confirm both devices are signed in to the same Apple Account and that Linger is enabled under iOS Settings → [your name] → iCloud. Sync happens in the background, so give it a minute on a good connection.

How do TV shows and episodes work?

Open a show to see its episodes by season. Check off an episode and your progress moves with it. You can add a note to any episode. New episodes arrive on their own, and your notes and watched dates are kept.

Where can I watch a show?

Open the title. A Watch on section lists where a show streams when that is known, and Where it's streaming opens a search for the rest.

What is a saved filter?

A list that fills itself from rules, such as kind, unfinished, pinned, release year, or a word in your notes. It updates as you pin, finish, or add titles. You can't file a title onto it by hand; edit its rules from the list's ••• menu.

I deleted something by mistake.

Tap Undo on the banner right after deleting. Later, open the Finished tab and use Recently deleted to restore it. Deleted titles are kept for 30 days.

How do I watch or read something again?

Open it in your Finished history and tap Enjoy again.

Why does Plan ask about my location?

Only if you give an event a location and ask for its forecast. Linger uses Apple WeatherKit for that, and uses your location only when you ask.

A search can't find my title.

Add it by hand, or try a shorter search. Articles, places, restaurants, and websites are always added by hand. If a title is missing or wrong, email us.
